description: This file contains implementation code for folding convolution and batch normalization layers in PyTorch's JIT compiler, including pattern matching, parameter extraction, and graph rewriting.

classes.name: FoldConvBatchNormHelper
classes.description: Helper class for analyzing and transforming modules to fold convolution and batch normalization layers.

methods.name: computeUpdatedConvWeightAndBias
methods.description: Computes new convolution weights and biases after folding batch normalization parameters.

methods.name: replaceConvBiasWithGetAttr
methods.description: Replaces convolution bias with a getAttr node in the graph.

methods.name: addBiasForConvIfNone
methods.description: Adds bias attribute to convolution modules if missing.

methods.name: tryExtractingConvBNParameters
methods.description: Extracts convolution and batch norm parameters from modules.

methods.name: analyze
methods.description: Analyzes modules to find convolution-batch norm patterns and records necessary information.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Applies the recorded transformations to fold conv and batch norm layers.
